First public release of **JD Highlighter**, a pair of borderless themes for JDownloader 2 with one accent colour you pick yourself: **JD Highlighter Dark** on IBM Carbon `#161616` and **JD Highlighter Light** on `#f4f4f4`. Both have rounded cards, clean line icons and large fills that stay neutral, so text reads well at any hue. They run on the desktop app and in the JDownloader-for-Unraid container. Download `jd-highlighter-v1.0.0.zip`, unzip it, run the installer for your OS and restart JDownloader; the README covers the installer options and uninstalling.

## ✨ Added

- **Theme agent.** `jd-highlighter-agent.jar` handles what JD hard-codes: it swaps the chrome icons for [Tabler](https://tabler.io/icons) line icons (MIT), lays the lists and settings sections onto rounded cards, rounds the buttons, turns the menu bar into pills, makes menus and dialogs borderless and replaces the coloured progress globes with a plain accent ring. Hoster lists show each site's own colour logo instead of JD's grey placeholder, and the donate tab's holiday icons get a line icon too. The agent is built for Java 8, so it loads on every Java that JDownloader ships with, bundles [ASM](https://asm.ow2.io/) (BSD-3-Clause) and is the same agent the container uses.
- **A free accent, picked in JD.** Settings › User Interface has an Accent colour row with a colour picker and an Appearance row for Dark or Light. JD offers a restart after a change. Any colour works, default `#ffee00`, and text on the accent switches between dark and light automatically.
- **Installers** for Windows (`install/install.bat`, `install/install.ps1`) and Linux/macOS (`install/install.sh`). They install Dark, or Light with `-Variant light` (Windows) or a third argument `light` (Linux/macOS), pick the matching FlatLaf look and feel, switch off JD's ads, render the accent and load the agent through JDownloader's `.vmoptions`. If JD has not used a FlatLaf design before, it downloads one on the first start and restarts once more on its own. Running the installers again is safe, and `install/uninstall.ps1` / `install/uninstall.sh` remove everything again.
- **Container support.** In the JDownloader-for-Unraid container JD Highlighter Dark is the default. There the Appearance row also offers the plain Carbon looks, JD Plain Dark and JD Plain Light, and the pick and the accent are kept in `/config`, so they survive image updates.

## 🎨 Design

- **Colours for JD's own content areas.** `theme/cfg/laf/FlatDarkLaf.json` and `FlatLightLaf.json` set the Carbon `colorfor*` palette for the download list, link grabber, settings table and scrollbars, with the same two-path technique as the dark theme in the JDownloader-for-Unraid container and JD Plain Dark. The lists sit on a card (`#242424` in Dark, white in Light), the selection stays a readable grey, and the hover row takes the accent.
- **Control theme.** The two `.properties` templates in `theme/flatlaf/` make fields, combos and buttons borderless, give everything one 8px corner radius and carry the accent to toggles, tabs, menus, focus and progress.
- **Lists in the accent.** Progress bars and the speed graph take the accent, and the percentages on the bars stay readable. Every file type and every status gets its own line glyph (on Windows too, where JD used the system's icons), and the status bar drops its row of account icons.
